candidates.title: The CORRECT way to hold the kettlebell front rack✅
candidates.description:
🔥The Front Rack: Do’s and Dont’s🔥

The front rack position while really basic is a very important part of maximizing your kettlebell training✅

I see a lot of messy front racks floating around the inter webs so let me break from the proper front in these very easy to follow steps✅

1️⃣Have the handle of the kettlebell cutting across the meaty part of your hand

2️⃣Point your knuckles to the ceiling and have a strong wrist 

3️⃣Keep your elbow as tight to your body as possible and keep a vertical forearm

Drop a comment below and let me know what exercises you’d like to see me breakdown next💪🏻

#kettlebell #kettlebells #kettlebellworkout
